blender.operation.importSpatialLayer: Imports the spatial layer of a scene from a Blender export: rewrites the initial placement records of the scene config and the decoration records of the paired presentation document. It touches no other fields of those documents (BLND-2); findings of error severity reject the import as a whole (BLND-6).
blender.operation.param.scene: The scene config — the document whose initial placement the import rewrites.
blender.operation.param.presentation: The paired presentation document of the scene — the document whose decorations the import rewrites. When it is not named the layer must carry no decorations, otherwise the import refuses.
blender.operation.param.layer: The target spatial layer: the `initial` and `decorations` record lists and the findings of parsing the source. A slot this operation does not write is a refusal, not a silent skip.
blender.operation.param.initialPath: Where the placement list lives in the scene config; absent means `initial` (SER-8).
blender.operation.param.decorationsPath: Where the decoration list lives in the paired document; absent means `decorations` (PRES-2).
validation.rule.blender.spatialLayerSync: Compares the spatial layer of a scene with what importing its Blender source would produce. A divergence is a warning: the document is valid, but the next import will overwrite the edit (BLND-2). For a scene without a source the rule stays silent.
validation.reason.blender.spatialLayerSy: The "{slot}" layer diverged from source "{source}": the next import will overwrite this edit — run the import or edit in Blender (BLND-2)
Source "{source}" sits next to the scene but the environment did not read it: there is nothing to compare the layer against: {reason}
Source "{source}" does not pass the import: there is nothing to compare the layer against until the source is fixed: {reason} (BLND-6)
Validation rule "{rule}" failed on this document: nothing was checked, and that is a defect of the rule, not of the document.
